summary.text: Alonzo Knox is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 93 in Orleans Parish, first elected in 2023. The House's member page lists Alonzo L. Knox's committees as Administration of Criminal Justice, Appropriations, and Municipal, Parochial and Cultural Affairs, and as vice chair of the Democratic Caucus.

paragraphs.text: According to the Louisiana House member page, Alonzo L. Knox is an entrepreneur.
The page lists an M.B.A. from Trinity University, a B.A. in political science from Southern University and A&M College, and an A.A. in law enforcement from Southern University and A&M College.
It lists caucus affiliations with the Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus, the Orleans Delegation, and the STEM Innovation Caucus.
